# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V0001 syntax_error"
description: "The parser expected a different token, or a delimiter was never closed."
---

An error from the `parse` phase. `sakura explain V0001` prints this explanation offline.

The parser expected a different token, or a delimiter was never closed.

The parser recovers and keeps going, so later diagnostics may be cascades of this one;
fix this one first.

Wrong:

```sakura
fn main() -> Unit ! {Console} { Console.print("hi" }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
fn main() -> Unit ! {Console} { Console.print("hi") }
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V0001_unterminated_call.fixed.sakura`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V0001_unterminated_call.fixed.sakura), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:
